_description: SentinelHub / CDSE connectivity configuration. The credentials file itself is gitignored — this file only records where to find it and which endpoint to use. Agents MUST load credentials via src.sentinel_queryutils_listings._load_sh_config, NOT by reading this file directly.
notes: CDSE catalog rejects item_ids= parameter — always use ids=[] or date+bbox search with prefix matching.
Strip _COG suffix from scene IDs before catalog lookup.
TLS handshake may hang on macOS/Python 3.9 if SentinelConfig is constructed inline — always use _load_sh_config.
